family.name: bounded Erdős–Straus constructions
family.candidate: integer tuple or versioned numeric template with declared domain
family.certificate: exact (immutable verifier across all ten arms)
family.development_reuse: P57 instances as development only, never as fresh test

dev_note: Small composite n with classical coverage; disjoint from any future P71 fresh final by construction (P71 finals will be newly frozen). Known/false controls stay outside the discovery metric.
seed_rule: Repeated seeds are repeats within a task, not independent problems.
comparison: baseline versus one hypothesis at a time
budget_rule: Ceiling includes collection and training; full cost (collection+train+search+checker+tracking) presented; amortization projections labeled with horizon, never observations.
primary_outcome: certified tasks on the same set; capped time-to-certificate as co-measure

screening.PROMISING: same set has more certified tasks, or at least 20% lower capped time-to-certificate without success drop
screening.BLOCKED: correctness, data, required-approval or isolation failure

screening_note: Operational triage choice, not statistical proof; six tasks/three seeds do not guarantee power or confirmation.
censoring: Timeouts are censored observations and never dropped from the analysis; report all arms, tasks and seeds, group intervals and distinct solutions.
